means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the victim way chosen by find_victim has its field greater than or equal to zero, and the table entry divided by div is strictly greater than that victim way's field. False if the table entry is absent or if the victim way's field is strictly less than zero. Nothing is written.
name: predicted_exceeds_live_victim

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, and either the table entry is greater than or equal to 95, or the victim way chosen by find_victim has its field greater than or equal to 0 and the table entry divided by div is strictly greater than that victim way's field. False if the table entry is absent or if neither condition holds. Nothing is written.
name: smart_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is strictly greater than the limit, or both the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: better_bypass

means: Reads the state field. If the value is between 1 and 15 inclusive, returns the value minus 1. If the value is 0, returns 16. If the value is 16 or greater, returns the value plus 1, clamped to 31.
name: tick_mockingjay

means: True when the signed per_line field of the way being visited is strictly greater than min_val. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: signed_gt

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero, and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: safe_exceeds_victim

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, and either the table entry is greater than or equal to stream_thresh, or both the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: strict_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is strictly greater than the limit, or no way of the set has its field strictly less than zero and the table entry divided by div is strictly greater than the maximum of that field across all ways of the set. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: resident_aware_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, and its value divided by div is strictly greater than the sum of the absolute values of the field across all ways in the set divided by the number of ways, plus the margin. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: bypass_exceeds_average

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is greater than or equal to stream_thresh, or every way in the access's set has its field greater than or equal to zero and the maximum of that field across all ways of the set is strictly greater than zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is greater than or equal to that maximum. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: dynamic_resident_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either: (1) the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and either the table entry is strictly greater than limit or the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way; or (2) the field of the victim way is strictly less than zero, the table entry is strictly greater than limit, and the number of ways in the access set whose field is greater than or equal to zero is greater than or equal to min_live. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: dynamic_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the sum of margin and the average of the absolute values of the field across all ways in the access set (using integer division for the average). False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: resident_average_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either: (1) the sum of the field across all ways of the access's set is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry is strictly greater than the limit; or (2) the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: thrash_aware_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is strictly greater than the limit, or no way in the access's set has its field strictly less than zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the maximum of that field across all ways of the access's set. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: dynamic_max_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is strictly greater than the limit, or both the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: safe_victim_bypass

means: True when the signed per_line field of the way being visited is strictly greater than min_val. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: signed_greater

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either: (1) the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and either the table entry is strictly greater than limit or the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way; or (2) the field of the victim way is strictly less than zero, the table entry is strictly greater than limit, and at least one way in the access set has its field greater than or equal to zero. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: live_relative_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is strictly greater than the limit, or both the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the sum of that field of the victim way and the margin. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: margin_better_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either: (1) its value is strictly greater than stream_limit; or (2) at least one way in the access set has its field greater than or equal to zero, and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the maximum of that field among all ways in the access set whose field is greater than or equal to zero. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: live_max_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either its value is strictly greater than the limit, or both the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: mj_better_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero, and either the table entry is strictly greater than the limit or the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: live_victim_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero, and either the table entry is strictly greater than the limit or the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: strict_live_bypass

means: True when the signed per_line field of the way being visited is strictly greater than min_val. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: signed_greater_than

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero, and either the table entry is strictly greater than the limit or the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: overdue_guarded_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and either: (1) its value is greater than or equal to stream_thresh; or (2) the field of the victim way chosen by find_victim is greater than or equal to zero, and either the table entry is strictly greater than limit or the table entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than that field of the victim way. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: overdue_victim_bypass
